# Working in this project

This repository is a research-method skill framework. For research tasks, read `skills/using-research-superpowers/SKILL.md`, then relevant method/core skills. For framework maintenance, inspect affected files and preserve methodological consistency.

Do not treat illustrative numbers as empirical results. Do not claim installed host integration, trained models, completed experiments or publication readiness from a passing static validator.

Keep standard skill name/description frontmatter, specific triggers, actionable procedures, deliverables and limits. Register methods in the router and catalog. Avoid wholesale external collections or dependencies.

Validate with `python scripts/validate_project.py` and `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.

Keep raw sensitive data, credentials and research outputs in downstream projects. Follow requested scope and authorization; routine reversible choices do not require approval gates.
